(<ab>Nom.</ab> <ab>sing.</ab> {#uSanA#};
 <ab>Voc.</ab> <ab>sing.</ab> {#uSanan, uSana, uSanaH#}) <ab>N.</ab> of Śukra, regent of the planet
 Venus, son of Bhṛgu and preceptor of the Asuras. In the Vedas he has
 the epithet (or patronymic name) {%Kāvya%} given to him, probably because
 he was noted for his wisdom; {#mitrAvaruRAvuSanAM kAvyam#} ({#avaTaH#})
 <ls>Av. 4. 29. 6</ls>. <ab>cf.</ab> {#kavInAmuSanA kaviH#} <ls>Bg. 10. 37</ls>; He is also known
 as a writer on civil and religious law (<ls>Y. 1. 4</ls>). and as an authority on
 civil polity; {#SAstramuSanasA praRItam#} <ls>Pt. 5</ls>; {#aDyApitasyoSanasApi#}
 {#nItim#} <ls>Ku. 3. 6</ls>.
